== Template:Item/Aura ==

Template for displaying aura item tooltips. Auras provide permanent party-wide buff effects.

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Required !! Description
|-
| '''image''' || Yes || Item icon image filename
|-
| '''name''' || Yes || Aura item name
|-
| '''value''' || No || Item value in gold, or "Unsellable"
|-
| '''aura_spell_name''' || No || Aura spell name (displayed in green)
|-
| '''aura_spell_desc''' || No || Aura spell description (from SpellDesc field)
|-
| '''aura_spell_icon''' || No || Spell icon image filename (displays in spell details)
|-
| '''aura_*''' || No || Various aura effect parameters (see Item/SpellDetails)
|}

=== Aura Mechanics ===

* Auras affect the entire party
* Auras of the same type do not stack
* Effect is applied once item is acquired

=== Example ===

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/Aura
|image=Aged Prism.png
|name=Aged Prism
|aura_spell_name=Aura: The Prism
|aura_spell_desc=Increase party resists
|aura_spell_icon=Aura: The Prism.png
|aura_spell_level=22
|aura_spell_duration_ticks=2
|aura_spell_type=Beneficial
|aura_spell_line=Aura_Buff_Resists
|aura_mr=8
|aura_er=8
|aura_pr=8
|aura_vr=8
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/Aura
|image=Aged Prism.png
|name=Aged Prism
|aura_spell_name=Aura: The Prism
|aura_spell_desc=Increase party resists
|aura_spell_icon=Aura: The Prism.png

|aura_mr=8

|aura_vr=8
}}
